features:
• CRISPY BISCUIT SANDWICHES: Wholesome, creamy coconut butter biscuits made with whole grain oats; A must-have for an on-the-go snack or in a lunch box

  • CONTAINS: One 6.75 oz box of Nature Valley Coconut Butter Biscuit Sandwiches; 5 count
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Coconut Oil, Corn Starch, Corn Syrup, Canola Oil, Palm Oil, Coconut Flour, Toasted Coconut, Honey, Whole Grain Barley Flakes, Palm Kernel Oil, Salt, Baking Soda, Soy Lecithin, Natural Flavor.
